items.title: Running Sum of 1d Array
items.teaches: Carry a total across a loop and build a result array as you go.

items.title: Concatenation of Array
items.teaches: Read an array twice in one pass and push onto a new array.

items.title: Fizz Buzz
items.teaches: Order your conditions so the combined case is tested first.

items.title: Reverse String
items.teaches: Change an array in place by swapping from both ends.

items.title: Length of Last Word
items.teaches: Deal with trailing spaces before you split text apart.

items.title: Plus One
items.teaches: Walk an array backwards and carry a digit, the way you add on paper.

items.title: Move Zeroes
items.teaches: Keep a write position that moves slower than the read position.

items.title: Missing Number
items.teaches: Compare what a total should be against what it is.

items.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
items.teaches: Track the best answer so far and the cheapest price so far in one pass.

items.title: Is Subsequence
items.teaches: Advance two positions at different speeds through two strings.

items.title: Valid Palindrome
items.teaches: Clean input first, then compare it against itself reversed.

items.title: Longest Common Prefix
items.teaches: Shrink a candidate answer until every input agrees with it.

items.title: Binary Search
items.teaches: Halve the search space each step using low, high and middle.

items.title: Merge Sorted Array
items.teaches: Merge two sorted lists from the back so you never overwrite unread data.

items.title: Fibonacci Number
items.teaches: Keep only the last two values instead of the whole sequence.

items.title: Climbing Stairs
items.teaches: Recognise a counting problem that is the same shape as Fibonacci.

items.title: Contains Duplicate
items.teaches: Use a Set to remember what you have already seen.

items.title: Valid Anagram
items.teaches: Count letters once per string and compare the two counts.

items.title: Ransom Note
items.teaches: Spend from a count of available letters instead of searching repeatedly.

items.title: Majority Element
items.teaches: Count occurrences in a Map and find the largest count.

items.title: Two Sum
items.teaches: Store what you have seen so the partner of each number is one lookup away.

items.title: Roman to Integer
items.teaches: Look ahead one character to decide whether to add or subtract.

items.title: Happy Number
items.teaches: Detect a loop by remembering every value you have produced.

items.title: Valid Parentheses
items.teaches: Use an array as a stack so the newest opener is the first to close.

items.title: Reverse Linked List
items.teaches: Walk a chain of objects and turn each link around without losing the rest.

items.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
items.teaches: Build a new chain by repeatedly taking the smaller head.

items.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
items.teaches: Let a function call itself on each half of a tree.
